## Human Review Scope

- [ ] Documentation has been reviewed by a human when this PR changes `README.md`, `docs/**`, `AGENTS.md`, or `.github/**`.
- [ ] Permission, privacy, Agent action, or workflow behavior changes are called out explicitly.
- [ ] Any sensitive Android capability change includes risk and rollback notes.

## Notes

- PRs into `dev` should use GitHub-hosted CI and emulator checks.
- PRs from `dev` into `main` require maintainer approval and, once available, physical-device smoke checks.
